stem: How does a GA4 key event become a conversion that Google Ads can bid on?

options.text: Link GA4 to Google Ads and create or import a Google Ads conversion from the key event
Change the reporting attribution model to Google paid channels last click so Ads can use it
Link BigQuery and export the key event daily, so Google Ads can read it from the dataset
Build an audience of users who triggered it and share that audience with Google Ads
